links.note: Van Mahotsav, the festival of forests, celebrated to promote awareness about the value of trees and forest conservation through community plantation drives - this concept's example. Already linked and correct.

A truck driver transporting goods from one place to another is named in this concept's list of economic activities. Already linked and correct.

Tending one's own garden against a farmer selling produce is the same comparison this concept is built on - the identical task differing only in whether payment is involved. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.
The grandfather's free teaching set against a schoolteacher's paid teaching - this concept's THINK ABOUT IT, chosen so that only the payment differs. Already linked and correct.

The sentence quoted in the stem, that activities are divided into two groups, economic and non-economic, is this concept's own, and the question asks how firm that division is. Already linked and correct.

Classifying the farmers' unpaid check-dam labour turns on this concept's test, whether money or money's worth changes hands, which is what the first sub-prompt asks. Already linked and correct.
